name: cc-mod-caffeinate
description: Keep the Mac's screen awake with caffeinate only while Claude is actively working

keepAwakeLidClosed.title: Stay awake with the lid closed
keepAwakeLidClosed.description: Also prevent system sleep (caffeinate -s) while Claude works, so it keeps going with the lid closed. AC power only.

showStatus.title: Show ☕ in the prompt footer
showStatus.description: Show a ☕ beside the mode labels under the prompt while the screen is held.

backgroundHoldMinutes.title: Max minutes to hold for background jobs
backgroundHoldMinutes.description: Release the screen this long after Claude's turn ends, even if background jobs still run. 0 holds until they finish.
